name: Kesst Vayr
notes: Zhilakai — flightless, in a city whose nobility is winged. Pangrella's own facts name the Zhilakai as its shadow power and its standing tension as 'winged nobility against merchant castes'; Kesst works the seam between the two. Rules race is human (PF1e); Zhilakai is her people in the world, not a game race. The two are tracked separately on purpose.
